metadata.mechanics: At least 3 members who share the same Society Membership may engage in a 30 minute bonding activity of roleplay appropriate to the Society, each expending 5 Mind. Once complete, for the rest of the event the Bleed Out timer for each participant is increased by 10 minutes so long as they entered Bleed Out within arm's reach of another known member of that Society.
metadata.validTargetDescription: At least 3 Targets (Both) who share the same Society Membership
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: Every society is bound together by shared traditions; whether this be the 'church' held by biker gangs, lively academic debates by scholarly groups, or recitations of various creeds and oaths from secret organizations, these group activities bring the society closer together and can even inspire their members to hold on even in the face of death - so long as their fellows are there beside them. These activities vary widely between societies, but should be at least semi-organized and ritualized, reinforcing group solidarity.
